pages.text: Every 40 work ticks, scans fluid containers within a centered horizontal 3x3 area and two blocks above/below. Drains 1000mB each of white, green, yellow, oolong, red and black tea in order. No partial reward: completing all six pays 76800 mana. A full cache preserves the last bucket. Wrong tea or less than a bucket is untouched. Progress saves.
